strings.errduplicategradeidnumber: Error - there are two grade items with idnumber '{$a}' in this course. This should be impossible.
strings.errincorrectgradeidnumber: Error - idnumber '{$a}' from the import file does not match any grade item.
strings.errincorrectuseridnumber: Error - idnumber '{$a}' from the import file does not match any user.
strings.errorduringimport: An error occurred when trying to import: {$a}
strings.fileurl_help: The remote file URL field is for fetching data from a remote server, such as a student information system.
strings.importxml_help: Grades can be imported via an XML file containing user ID numbers and activity ID numbers. To obtain the correct format, first export some grades to XML file then view the file.
strings.privacy:metadata: The import grades from XML plugin does not store any personal data.
